Title: 【Group】Concerts Played with Traditional Instruments in Kyoto
Description:
This experience is a concert held in a cozy home, different from the traditional townhouses and temples of Kyoto.
It feels like being in a Japanese family's home, filled with warmth and a sense of real life.


The program begins with a brief explanation of Japanese traditional instruments such as the koto and shamisen, as well as their unique sheet music. After the introduction, you will enjoy a live performance by professional musicians. Following the performance, there will be a Q&A session with the performers and an opportunity for photo-taking, allowing you to gain a deeper understanding of the instruments and create unforgettable memories.


The concert features a diverse repertoire, including classical pieces, contemporary compositions, and original works. The program changes depending on the season or the performer, offering a variety of musical experiences.


You will be surrounded by the delicate sounds of the koto and shamisen, enjoying the intimate atmosphere. This experience is perfect for adventurous travelers and families, promising a special and memorable time.

Title: Traditional Japanese Instrument Concert at Gen Soundbath Kujo-yu
Description:
This experience is a concert held at Kujo-yu, a renovated sento near Kyoto Station. 

The unique acoustics of the sento create a remarkable setting for listening to the koto and shamisen, with the music filling the entire space and leaving a profound and lingering impression.

The concert features a diverse program, ranging from classical to contemporary pieces, and even original arrangements. 

The repertoire changes depending on the season and the performer, offering a fresh and varied musical experience each time.

Perfect for adventurous travelers and families, this experience promises a special and unforgettable time.

Title: 【Group】Koto Lesson in a Traditional Japanese Home
Description:
Experience the beauty of Japanese traditional music together through an interactive koto workshop held in a real local home.


This program is perfect for families, school groups, or travel parties who want to enjoy a warm, hands-on cultural experience.


You’ll start by learning how to sit and pluck the strings, then gradually move up through three levels.


At the end, everyone will play the melody together — creating a joyful moment of shared music and connection.
